Title: 2000 High School Basketball Capsules
Subtitle: The Savannah Morning News boys basketball preview for Karl Demasi's first St. Andrew's season.
Summary: The boys basketball preview listed Karl Demasi as St. Andrew's first-year head coach after a 25-7 season and identified Chris Love, Randall Phillips, Patrick Burns, and Justin Dixon as key players for a smaller, up-tempo Saints team.
SourceCitation: "2000 HIGH SCHOOL BASKETBALL CAPSULES," Savannah Morning News (GA), November 22, 2000, Page 4D, Sports.
ArchiveNote: This archive page preserves citation details and an original summary. The full newspaper text is not republished here.
Transcript: The Savannah Morning News boys basketball preview listed Karl Demasi as St. Andrew's first-year coach and noted the Saints were coming off a 25-7 season. The preview described the roster as short but interchangeable, with an up-tempo approach, and listed Chris Love, Randall Phillips, Patrick Burns, and Justin Dixon as key players. The article printed Love as the surname; the site roster also contains Chris Lowe from this class era, so the article spelling is preserved in the summary.

Title: Durrence's Pinewood Faces New Challenge
Subtitle: The Savannah Morning News private-school basketball preview included St. Andrew's boys basketball returnees for Karl Demasi's second season.
Author: C. Edward Wilson
Byline: C. Edward Wilson, Savannah Morning News
Summary: The private-school basketball preview listed Karl Demasi as St. Andrew's second-year boys basketball coach and identified Jeff Smith, Patrick Burns, and Davy Clay as key returnees after Tobi Specht and Justin Dixon graduated.
SourceCitation: C. Edward Wilson, "DURRENCE'S PINEWOOD FACES NEW CHALLENGE," Savannah Morning News (GA), November 16, 2001, Page 1C, Sports.
ArchiveNote: This archive page preserves citation details and an original summary. The full newspaper text is not republished here.
Transcript: The Savannah Morning News private-school basketball preview listed Karl Demasi as St. Andrew's second-year boys basketball coach. The preview said the Saints were coming off a 16-11 season, had lost Tobi Specht and Justin Dixon, and returned junior guard Jeff Smith, junior forward Patrick Burns, and sophomore guard Davy Clay. It described Demasi's teams as quick and tenacious defensively and said the Saints' goal was to return to the state playoffs.
